w: A hospital, offered by the Mahalaxmi Charitable Trust to the BAPS, was equipped with the latest medical facilities by the Sanstha. The inaugural function took place in the presence of Swamishri, Chief Minister of Gujarat - Shri Keshubhai Patel and the State Health Minister - Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt. 'Pramukh Swami Hospital' was declared open amidst Vedic chantings by Swamishri and Shri Keshubhai Patel.
Swamishri's car broke down on the road towards Surat. (For details see photo story )
At 11.40 am Swamishri departed by plane from Bhavnagar and landed at Surat airport at 12.00 noon. Thereafter Swamishri proceeded by road towards Navsari, reaching the BAPS mandir at 1.10 pm.

In the evening assembly, after Viveksagar Swami’s discourse on the Vachanamrut, Swamishri was welcomed with garlands offered by sadhus and devotees. Thereafter a welcome dance was performed by BAPS children and youths. Then the youths performed a drama based on the theme of atma-gnan from the Upanishads – Sanatkumar and Naradji. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
A small boy came and said to Swamishri, "Stay with me."
Swamishri said, "Remember God, and He will always be with you."
Swamishri was doing darshan in Shastriji Maharaj's room. Sadhus, parshads and sadhaks were sitting along both walls of the room. A crowd for darshan had gathered at the door too.
Then Mayur Ajmera, standing in front, said, "Shastriji Maharaj used to say that we are the bullocks of Akshar Purushottam. We too want to be bullocks of Akshar Purushottam. How can we become that?"

"I see!" Picking up the thread, Swamishri said, "Whoever is yoked to God's commands, is engaged in seva and keeps dharma and rules has become His devotee, that is, His bullock. If we do devotion and seva by His commands, God is pleased. A bullock is yoked however you yoke it. In the same way we must act by the commands."
